description: Treatment arm for the 2026-08-06 YouTube-corpus A/B. States the shipped defaults explicitly so the arm is self-documenting and so the two arms differ only in these values. F001 seeks Hidden when moving, F002 prices the two-turn cost of surrendering it by shooting, F003 shoots enemies about to regain it, F004 charges movement for the Overwatch it newly exposes the unit to, F009 plays for battle-shock as objective denial. DEEP_STRIKE_DENIAL_RANGE_PX is deliberately absent so the F007 derivation from GameConstants.reinforcement_min_enemy_distance_inches() (11e: >8") is active.
